plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing plan built for a beginner with short 30-minute sessions and an endurance priority. Week 1 establishes simple baseline strength numbers on one main lift per session so future loading is grounded and safe, then Weeks 2-4 build aerobic capacity, repeat-effort conditioning, and basic strength-power support without adding unnecessary fatigue. The main program starts in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish baseline strength, build aerobic capacity, and groove simple full-body strength and power patterns.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress conditioning density and basic strength while keeping sessions short and recoverable around boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep the engine strong and express it with sharper sport-relevant repeat efforts and cleaner explosive work.
